paite: Huchi in Baasha kalh in Hanani tapa Jehu kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
"Leivui a pan ka hon domsang a, ka mi Israelte tung ah heutu in ka hon bawl hi. Nang Jeroboam lampi zuih na tawn a, akhelhnate a hon hehsak ding in ka mi Israelte thil na hihkhialsak hi.
Ngai in, Baasha leh a-inkote ka hihmang ding hi. Huchi in Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote bang mai in na inkote ka bawl ding.
Baasha inkote lak a mi khopi a si peuhmah ui in ane dia; a-inkote lak a mi gamlak a si peuhmah tungleng vasate'n ane ding uh," chi in.
Baasha tanchin dangte, athilhihte leh athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Baasha apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Tirzah ah avui ua; asik in atapa Elah alal hi.

Baasha leh a-inkote tungtang thu ah akhutsuak a TOUPA hehsak dia Jeroboam inkote batna nei a TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou mahmah ahih ziak leh amah athah ziak in Hanani tapa zawlnei Jehu zang a agen TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-gukna ah Baasha tapa Elah, Tirzah ah Israelte tung ah alal pan a, kum nih alal hi,
heading: Israel Kumpipa Elah

paite: Asikha Zimri, akangtalai kimkhat tung a heutu in Tirzah ah amah gukthah asawm hi. Huchih lai in, Tirzah ah insung lam heutu Arza inn ah amah zukham in a-om hi.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-sagih in Zimri lut in ava sual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ahong lal pan a, alaltutphah a ahong tuttak in, Baasha inko tengteng athat vek a; atanaute leh alawmte lak a mi pasal photphot khat leng ahawi kei hi.
Huchi in zawlnei Jehu zang a Baasha kalh a agen, TOUPA thu bang in, Zimri in Baasha inko tengteng athat vek hi;
TOUPA, Israelte’ Pathian, hehsak dia aginatlouhna ua, atohthoh ua, Baasha khelhnate leh atapa Elah khelhnate a amaute akhelh ua, huai mah a Israelte akhelhsak ziak un.
Elah tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-sagihna ah Zimri, Tirzah ah ni sagih alal hi. Philistiate neihsa, Gibbethon a mite'n a-um uhi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Zimri

paite: A-um mite'n, "Zimri in aguksawm a, kumpipa athat," chih agen uh ana za ua; huchi in Israel tengteng in sepaih heutu, Omri, huai ni in agiahmun uah Israelte tung a kumpipa in abawl uhi.
Omri bel Israel tengteng toh Gibbethon a pan in ahohtou ua, Tirzah ava um uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Zimri in khua ala uh chih atheih in, kumpipa' inn a kulh ah atailut a, kumpipa' inn ah akibuhal a, asita hi;
TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou mahmah hih a akhelhnate ziak leh Jeroboam lampi tawn a Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, akhelh ziak in.
Zimri tanchin dangte leh asawmgukna thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Israel mite pawl nih in akikhenta ua; mipi kimkhat in Ginath tapa Tibni kumpipa dia bawl tum in azui ua; akimkhat in Omri azui uhi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Omri

paite: Himahleh Omri zuite'n Ginath tapa Tibni zuite azou ua: huchi in Tibni asi a, Omri ahong lalta hi.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmthum-le-khatna ah Omri Israelte tung ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-nih alal a: Tirzah ah kum guk alal hi.
Shemer a Samaria mual dangka talent nih in alei a; mual tung ah khua asat a, akhosat min huai neipa Shemer min tam in Samaria asa hi.
Omri in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, ama a mi tengteng sang in thil ahihkhial thupi tuamse hi.
Nebat tapa Jeroboam dan tengteng ala a, aginatlouhna ziak ua TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian hehsak dia Israelte thil ahihkhelhsak bang in akhial samta hi.
Omri thilhih tanchin dangte leh athilhihtheihdan ahihlat thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Omri apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahab ahong lal hi.
Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmthum-le-giatna ah Israelte tung ah Omri tapa Ahab alal pan hi. Omri tapa Ahab, Samaria ah kum sawmnih-le-nih Israelte tung ah alal hi,
heading: Israel Kumpipa Ahab

paite: Omri tapa Ahab in ama a mi tengteng sang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna bang hih sam bangmah lou a ngai hileh kilawmtak in, Zidonte kumpipa Ethbaal tanu Jezebel zi in anei a, Baal nna sem in abia hi.
Samaria a Baal inn alam ah Baal a ding in maitam adoh hi.
Ahab in Asherah abawl a; ama a Israel kumpipa tengteng sang in Ahab in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian hehsakna thil anak hih tungtuan hi.

Alal lai in Bethel mi Hiel in Jeriko khua asat a; atachil Abiram tanloh in asuangphum aphum hi. TOUPA'N Nun tapa Joshua zang a ana gensa bang in, anautum Segub tanloh hial in akulh kongkhakte adingkhesak hi.
